novelty_flags.label: Open-ended Question 2: complete width frontier
novelty_flags.one_line: Add PraharajKhamaru2025, which proves a single linear-contextual-bandit design with asymptotically valid Wald intervals and minimax-optimal regret; it does not subsume the proposed nonregular honest-width frontier but is a closer inference-plus-regret comparator than the current survey records.

soundness_flags.label: def:honest-intervals, def:width-envelope, and all downstream frontier statements
soundness_flags.one_line: I_T is only a random measurable interval, not one common measurable map of the observed trajectory, so the infimum does not exclude oracle dependence on P or unobserved potential outcomes.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 1: observable-law identification
soundness_flags.one_line: The displayed ratio follows directly by substituting the conditional mean into z_a and dividing by s_a, so it is a content-free root theorem rather than a substantive research target.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper lower-bounds the worst-case product of ATE point-estimation error and regret, gives EXP3E's finite-sample point-error bound, and characterizes Pareto optimality; it does not state an all-procedure honest-interval-width result.
The paper provides a bandit-model change-of-measure inequality, supporting its use as an ingredient rather than a solution of the proposed contextual honest-width problem.

The paper studies pathwise differentiability and inference for the mean outcome under an optimal individualized treatment strategy; it does not optimize adaptive data collection under a welfare budget.
The paper gives matched welfare-regret versus CATE-estimation tradeoffs and asymptotic normality in a contextual experiment, but not a uniform honest-width envelope for the proposed scalar gain.

The preprint proves adaptive asymptotic normality and efficiency for scalar pathwise-differentiable targets under directional stability, including a LinUCB instantiation; the proposed positive-part target is nonregular at ties and has an endogenous welfare budget.

The paper constructs penalized EXP4 with stable Wald inference for linear functionals and minimax-optimal regret up to logarithms, making it a required close comparator but not a subsuming result for nonparametric honest-width minimax inference.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define an interval procedure as one P-independent Borel-measurable map from observed trajectories (X_1,A_1,Y_1,…,X_T,A_T,Y_T) into closed connected intervals, and use that same map in every coverage and width infimum.

Replace Theorem 1 with a substantive necessary-and-sufficient exposure result: positive exposure identifies the gain, while zero exposure on a benchmark-relevant set admits explicit P,Q in the class with equal trajectory laws and separated targeting gains.

Add and distinguish Praharaj and Khamaru's 2025 stability-based linear-contextual result, then state precisely why its asymptotic Wald/linear-functional target and regret guarantee do not deliver a uniform nonregular honest-width frontier under a hard welfare budget.

recommended_next_step: Revise the interval-procedure domain and demote or strengthen the tautological exposure identity, then rerun novelty review with the missing stability-and-regret comparator incorporated.
